title: Systemic lupus erythematosus
summary: Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) with involvement of two or more organs/body systems, severe constitutional symptoms, OR repeated manifestations with marked limitation in one area of functioning.

children.criterion: Involvement of two or more organs/body systems with at least one moderate severity AND at least two constitutional symptoms
Lupus diagnosis with involvement of two or more organs/body systems (renal, skin, joint, cardiac, pulmonary, hematologic, neurologic)
At least one of the involved organ/body systems is at moderate level of severity
At least two constitutional symptoms or signs (severe fatigue, fever, malaise, involuntary weight loss)
Repeated manifestations of SLE with at least two constitutional symptoms AND marked limitation in one functional area
At least two constitutional symptoms (severe fatigue, fever, malaise, weight loss)
Marked limitation in activities of daily living, social functioning, or completing tasks in a timely manner
Marked limitation in activities of daily living
Marked limitation in maintaining social functioning
Marked limitation in completing tasks in a timely manner due to deficiencies in concentration, persistence, or pace
